name: Linseed Oil
description: Traditional oil medium; increases flow and gloss, slows drying.

name: Stand Oil
description: Thickened linseed oil; enamel-like finish, very slow drying.

name: Glazing Liquid
description: Extends drying time and transparency for acrylic glazes.

name: Gel Medium (Gloss)
description: Builds texture and body while maintaining gloss.

name: Matte Medium
description: Reduces gloss for a flat, matte paint film.

name: Water
description: Thins acrylics; increases transparency, reduces adhesion if over-thinned.
